contributions.author: Afloat16

contributions.title: fix(google-drive): prove folder name uniqueness before writes
contributions.head: 46f894534a81d6e33939c9fc6ee64a2eeed1d8c9
contributions.author: Afloat16
contributions.change: Request nextPageToken and incompleteSearch, follow up to 20 pages including empty pages, and stop as soon as the result is complete or distinct matches establish ambiguity. Refuse incompleteSearch or a continuation remaining at the 20-page limit with an explicit-folder-ID remedy; never accept an unproven unique result at the cap. Retain at most five distinct candidate IDs for the ambiguity message.
contributions.problem: Name-based folder resolution reads only one files.list page and omits incompleteSearch from its field mask. A later duplicate or an unsearched shared drive can therefore make mkdir, upload, document creation or move choose an unproven parent folder.
contributions.effectZh: Drive 按名称选择父文件夹前确认搜索完整且唯一，拒绝未完整搜索或截断结果，避免写入错误文件夹。
